    return blend(BG, col, a/255.0)

def hrule(y, x0, x1, col=RULE, t=2):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y+t], fill=col)

def dot_accent(x, y, col=RULE_BRIGHT, r=6):
    draw.ellipse([x-r, y-r, x+r, y+r], fill=col)

# ─── Subtle grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GS = 118
for gx in range(0, W, GS):
    draw.rectangle([gx, 0, gx+1, H], fill=GRID_COL)
for gy in range(0, H, GS):
    draw.rectangle([0, gy, W, gy+1], fill=GRID_COL)

ML = 164; MR = W-164; MCENTER = (ML+MR)//2

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MASTHEAD
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = 148

# Super-faint overline label
draw.text((ML, y), "JETBRAINS  ·  STATE OF DEVELOPER ECOSYSTEM  ·  2024",
          font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_GHOST)
y += 52
hrule(y, ML, MR, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)
y += 44

# Stacked title — BigShoulders for typographic impact
draw.text((ML, y), "STATE OF", font=fBig, fill=WHITE)
y += 218

draw.text((ML, y), "DEVELOPER", font=fBig, fill=WHITE)
y += 218

# "ECOSYSTEM" with JS-blue fill
draw.text((ML, y), "ECOSYSTEM", font=fBig, fill=C_JS)
y += 238

# Year stamp — large, right-aligned, amber, slightly behind title
yr_txt = "2024"
rt(yr_txt, MR, y - 310, fNum, abg(C_PY, 160))

# Tagline
y += 16
sub = "Language hierarchy is actively reshaping  ·  23,262 developers surveyed worldwide"
draw.text((ML, y), sub, font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y += 58

hrule(y, ML, MR, col=RULE, t=3)
y += 72

MAST_END = y

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION LABEL helper
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def section_header(y, label, x=None):
    if x is None: x = ML
    draw.text((x, y), label, font=fS_md, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
    hrule(y+56, x, MR if x==ML else x+500, col=RULE, t=2)
    dot_accent(x-1, y+57)
    return y+80

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CHART — Language trajectories 2017-2024
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CHART_START = MAST_END
CHART_START = section_header(CHART_START, "01  /  TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES  2017–2024")

CHART_L = ML + 80
CHART_R = MR - 40
CHART_T = CHART_START + 20
CHART_B = CHART_T + 900
CHART_W = CHART_R - CHART_L
CHART_H = CHART_B - CHART_T

years_main = [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]

def yx(yr):
    idx = years_main.index(yr)
    return CHART_L + int(idx/(len(years_main)-1)*CHART_W)

def vy(pct, maxp=76):
    return CHART_B - int((pct/maxp)*CHART_H)

# Horizontal guide bands
for gv in [20, 40, 60]:
    gy = vy(gv)
    draw.rectangle([CHART_L, gy, CHART_R, gy+1], fill=(30, 42, 60))
    draw.text((ML, gy-20), f"{gv}%", font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

hrule(CHART_B, CHART_L, CHART_R, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)

# Vertical year ticks + labels
for yr in years_main:
    vx = yx(yr)
    draw.rectangle([vx, CHART_T, vx+1, CHART_B], fill=(25, 35, 52))
    draw.rectangle([vx-1, CHART_B, vx+2, CHART_B+16], fill=RULE_BRIGHT)
    lbl = str(yr)
    draw.text((vx - tw(lbl, fJ_xs)//2, CHART_B+26), lbl, font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

# ─── Polyline drawer with optional fill ───────────────────────────────────────
def poly(pts, col, thick, filled=False, fill_alpha=30):
    if filled and len(pts) >= 2:
        # Area fill: polygon down to baseline
        poly_pts = list(pts) + [(pts[-1][0], CHART_B), (pts[0][0], CHART_B)]
        fc = abg(col, fill_alpha)
        draw.polygon(poly_pts, fill=fc)
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0 = pts[i]; x1,y1 = pts[i+1]
        # Multi-pass for thickness
        for off in range(-(thick//2), thick//2+1):
            draw.line([(x0,y0+off),(x1,y1+off)], fill=col, width=1)

def dashed(pts, col, thick):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0=pts[i]; x1,y1=pts[i+1]
        dx=x1-x0; dy=y1-y0
        dist=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
        n=max(int(dist/30),1)
        for s in range(n):
            t0=s/n; t1=(s+0.5)/n
            px0=int(x0+dx*t0); py0=int(y0+dy*t0)
            px1=int(x0+dx*t1); py1=int(y0+dy*t1)
            draw.line([(px0,py0),(px1,py1)],fill=col,width=thick)

def glow_dot(x, y, col, r=16):
    for gr in range(r*3, 0, -1):
        a = int(60 * (1 - gr/(r*3)))
        gc = abg(col, a)
        draw.ellipse([x-gr,y-gr,x+gr,y+gr], fill=gc)
    draw.ellipse([x-r,y-r,x+r,y+r], fill=col)

lang_series = [
    ("JavaScript", {2017:65,2019:69,2021:69,2023:61,2024:61}, C_JS,   9, True,  False),
    ("Python",     {2017:32,2019:49,2021:52,2023:54,2024:57}, C_PY,   9, True,  False),
    ("TypeScript", {2017:12,2019:25,2021:29,2023:34,2024:37}, C_TS,   8, True,  False),
    ("HTML/CSS",   {2017:60,2019:61,2021:60,2023:52,2024:51}, C_HTML, 3, False, True),
    ("SQL",        {2017:42,2019:56,2021:54,2023:52,2024:48}, C_SQL,  3, False, True),
    ("Java",       {2017:47,2019:50,2021:49,2023:49,2024:46}, C_JAVA, 3, False, True),
    ("Rust",       {2017: 0,2019: 6,2021: 8,2023: 7,2024: 8}, C_RUST, 5, False, False),
    ("Go",         {2017:17,2019:20,2021:23,2023:18,2024:17}, C_GO,   3, False, True),
]

# Draw muted first, hero on top
for lang, vals, col, thick, filled, dashy in lang_series:
    pts = [(yx(yr), vy(v)) for yr, v in sorted(vals.items()) if v > 0]
    if len(pts) < 2: continue
    if dashy:
        dashed(pts, col, thick)
    else:
        poly(pts, col, thick, filled=filled, fill_alpha=22)

# Hero dots + end labels
for lang, vals, col, thick, filled, dashy in lang_series:
    last_yr = max(vals)
    last_v  = vals[last_yr]
    if last_v == 0: continue
    ex,ey = yx(last_yr), vy(last_v)
    if thick >= 7:
        glow_dot(ex, ey, col, r=16)
    else:
        draw.ellipse([ex-9,ey-9,ex+9,ey+9], fill=col)

    # Label
    lx = ex + 30
    ly = ey - 22
    font = fS_sm if thick >= 7 else fJ_xs
    col2 = col if thick >= 7 else abg(col, 180)
    draw.text((lx, ly), f"{lang}  {last_v}%", font=font, fill=col2)

CHART_END = CHART_B + 80

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CALLOUT TRIO
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CT = CHART_END
CB = CT + 300
hrule(CT, ML, MR, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)
hrule(CB, ML, MR, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)

CW3 = (MR-ML)//3
ccx = [ML + CW3*i + CW3//2 for i in range(3)]

for i, cx_line in enumerate([ML+CW3, ML+CW3*2]):
    draw.rectangle([cx_line, CT, cx_line+2, CB], fill=RULE)

trios = [
    ("61%",    "JavaScript", "plateau · 2024",    C_JS),
    ("57%",    "Python",     "closing the gap",   C_PY),
    ("12→37%", "TypeScript", "8-year breakout",   C_TS),
]
for i,(num,lang,sub,col) in enumerate(trios):
    cx = ccx[i]
    ct(num,  cx, CT+38, fJ_lg, col)
    ct(lang, cx, CT+136, fS_md, WHITE)
    ct(sub,  cx, CT+194, fJ_xs, WHITE_FAINT)

TRIO_END = CB + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SPLIT: PROMISE INDEX (left) + DATABASES (right)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SP_TOP  = TRIO_END + 36
SP_MID  = MCENTER - 20
SP_BOT  = SP_TOP + 780

# Section labels
draw.text((ML, SP_TOP), "02  /  PROMISE INDEX", font=fS_md, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
hrule(SP_TOP+56, ML, SP_MID-60, col=RULE, t=2)
dot_accent(ML-1, SP_TOP+57)

draw.text((SP_MID+60, SP_TOP), "03  /  DATABASES", font=fS_md, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
hrule(SP_TOP+56, SP_MID+60, MR, col=RULE, t=2)
dot_accent(SP_MID+59, SP_TOP+57)

# Vertical divider
draw.rectangle([SP_MID, SP_TOP, SP_MID+2, SP_BOT], fill=RULE)

# ── Promise Index bars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PI_TOP = SP_TOP + 80
PI_L   = ML
PI_R   = SP_MID - 80
PI_W   = PI_R - PI_L
BAR_H  = 58
BAR_G  = 22

promise = [
    ("TypeScript", 199, C_TS),
    ("Rust",       198, C_RUST),
    ("Python",     151, C_PY),
    ("Go",         129, C_GO),
    ("Lua",        118, (155, 128, 200)),
    ("C++",        113, (120, 138, 158)),
    ("Kotlin",     113, (172, 118, 198)),
]
MAX_P = 210

for idx,(lang,score,col) in enumerate(promise):
    by  = PI_TOP + idx*(BAR_H+BAR_G)
    bw  = int((score/MAX_P)*PI_W)
    # Track
    draw.rectangle([PI_L, by, PI_R, by+BAR_H], fill=BG_PANEL)
    # Bar (gradient-ish: brighter at right edge)
    draw.rectangle([PI_L, by, PI_L+bw, by+BAR_H], fill=abg(col, 170))
    # Right edge accent
    draw.rectangle([PI_L+bw-4, by, PI_L+bw, by+BAR_H], fill=col)
    # Language name
    draw.text((PI_L+14, by+10), lang, font=fS_sm, fill=WHITE)
    # Score
    draw.text((PI_L+bw+14, by+10), str(score), font=fJ_sm, fill=col)

# Callout below bars
pn_y = PI_TOP + len(promise)*(BAR_H+BAR_G) + 30
# TypeScript promise callout box
box_pad = 24
box_w   = PI_W
box_h   = 130
draw.rectangle([PI_L, pn_y, PI_L+box_w, pn_y+box_h], fill=abg(C_TS, 14))
draw.rectangle([PI_L, pn_y, PI_L+4, pn_y+box_h], fill=C_TS)
draw.text((PI_L+box_pad, pn_y+16), "TypeScript  199  — highest promise score",
          font=fJ_xs, fill=C_TS)
draw.text((PI_L+box_pad, pn_y+62), "Surged 12% → 37% usage in 8 years",
          font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_DIM)

# ── Database trend lines ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_L  = SP_MID + 80
DB_R  = MR - 20
DB_T  = SP_TOP + 80
DB_B  = SP_BOT - 40
DB_W  = DB_R - DB_L
DB_H  = DB_B - DB_T

db_years = [2019, 2022, 2024]

def dyx(yr):
    idx = db_years.index(yr)
    return DB_L + int(idx/(len(db_years)-1)*DB_W)

def dvy(pct, maxp=68):
    return DB_B - int((pct/maxp)*DB_H)

# Guides
for gv in [20, 40, 60]:
    gy = dvy(gv)
    draw.rectangle([DB_L, gy, DB_R, gy+1], fill=(26, 36, 54))
    draw.text((DB_L, gy-28), f"{gv}%", font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

hrule(DB_B, DB_L, DB_R, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)

db_series = [
    ("PostgreSQL", {2019:32,2022:38,2024:45}, C_TS,   7, True),
    ("MySQL",      {2019:60,2022:52,2024:52}, C_JS,   6, True),
    ("MongoDB",    {2019:30,2022:27,2024:30}, C_PY,   4, False),
    ("SQLite",     {2019:29,2022:27,2024:30}, C_RUST, 4, False),
    ("Redis",      {2019:22,2022:18,2024:20}, C_GO,   3, False),
]

for lang,vals,col,thick,filled in db_series:
    pts = [(dyx(yr), dvy(v)) for yr,v in sorted(vals.items())]
    poly(pts, col, thick, filled=filled, fill_alpha=18)
    for px,py in pts:
        r = 10 if thick >= 6 else 7
        if thick >= 6:
            glow_dot(px, py, col, r=10)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([px-r,py-r,px+r,py+r], fill=col)
    # End label
    lx = pts[-1][0]+18; ly = pts[-1][1]-18
    v24 = vals[2024]
    draw.text((lx, ly), f"{lang}  {v24}%", font=fJ_xs, fill=col)

for yr in db_years:
    vx = dyx(yr)
    lbl = str(yr)
    draw.text((vx-tw(lbl,fJ_xs)//2, DB_B+20), lbl, font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

SP_END = SP_BOT + 60

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AI + CLOUD + PLATFORM ROW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AR_TOP = SP_END + 36
AR_TOP = section_header(AR_TOP, "04  /  AI INTEGRATION  ·  CLOUD  ·  PLATFORMS")

AR_COL_W = (MR-ML)//3
AR_BOT   = AR_TOP + 340

ar_centers = [ML + AR_COL_W//2, ML + AR_COL_W + AR_COL_W//2, ML + AR_COL_W*2 + AR_COL_W//2]

# Vertical dividers
for cx_ in [ML+AR_COL_W, ML+AR_COL_W*2]:
    draw.rectangle([cx_, AR_TOP-20, cx_+2, AR_BOT], fill=RULE)

# Col 1: AI stat
cx = ar_centers[0]
ct("18%", cx, AR_TOP, fJ_lg, C_TS)
ct("of developers", cx, AR_TOP+100, fS_sm, WHITE)
ct("build AI integrations", cx, AR_TOP+148, fJ_xs, WHITE_FAINT)
ct("Python: 31% AI/ML work", cx, AR_TOP+206, fJ_xs, abg(C_PY, 200))
ct("C++: 11% AI/ML work", cx, AR_TOP+248, fJ_xs, abg(C_RUST, 180))

# Col 2: Cloud stacked bar
CB_L   = ML + AR_COL_W + 30
CB_R   = ML + AR_COL_W*2 - 30
CB_W   = CB_R - CB_L
CB_TOP = AR_TOP + 20
CB_H   = 72
draw.text((CB_L, CB_TOP-36), "CLOUD PROVIDERS", font=fS_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
cloud = [("AWS",46,C_JS),("Azure",17,C_PY),("GCloud",11,C_TS),("Other",26,WHITE_FAINT)]
cx_off = 0
for cname,cpct,ccol in cloud:
    bw = int((cpct/100)*CB_W)
    bx = CB_L + cx_off
    draw.rectangle([bx, CB_TOP, bx+bw, CB_TOP+CB_H], fill=abg(ccol, 155))
    draw.rectangle([bx, CB_TOP+CB_H, bx+bw, CB_TOP+CB_H+4], fill=ccol)
    if bw > 90:
        pct_lbl = f"{cpct}%"
        draw.text((bx+12, CB_TOP+16), pct_lbl, font=fJ_xs, fill=WHITE)
    cx_off += bw

# legend below bar
lx_ = CB_L
for cname,cpct,ccol in cloud:
    bw = int((cpct/100)*CB_W)
    ct(cname, lx_+bw//2, CB_TOP+CB_H+24, fJ_xs, ccol)
    lx_ += bw

# Docker stat
docker_y = CB_TOP + CB_H + 90
ct("49%  use Docker locally", CB_L + CB_W//2, docker_y, fJ_xs, WHITE_DIM)

# Col 3: Platform bars
PL_L = ML + AR_COL_W*2 + 30
PL_R = MR - 24
PL_W = PL_R - PL_L
plat = [
    ("Browser",      58, C_JS),
    ("Server/Cloud", 56, C_PY),
    ("Desktop",      53, C_TS),
    ("Mobile",       30, C_RUST),
]
draw.text((PL_L, AR_TOP-36), "WHERE APPS RUN", font=fS_xs, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
for i,(pname,ppct,pcol) in enumerate(plat):
    py_ = AR_TOP + i*76
    bw_ = int((ppct/70)*PL_W)
    draw.rectangle([PL_L, py_, PL_L+bw_, py_+54], fill=abg(pcol, 135))
    draw.rectangle([PL_L+bw_-4, py_, PL_L+bw_, py_+54], fill=pcol)
    draw.text((PL_L+12, py_+9), pname, font=fS_xs, fill=WHITE)
    rt(f"{ppct}%", PL_L+bw_-12, py_+9, fJ_xs, pcol)

hrule(AR_BOT+20, ML, MR, col=RULE, t=2)
AR_END = AR_BOT + 60

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FY = H - 160
hrule(FY, ML, MR, col=RULE_BRIGHT, t=2)
FY += 36

ct("STATE OF DEVELOPER ECOSYSTEM  2024", MCENTER, FY, fJ_xs, WHITE_FAINT)
ct("Source: JetBrains State of Developer Ecosystem Report · 23,262 respondents worldwide",
   MCENTER, FY+48, fJ_xs, abg(WHITE_FAINT, 130))

# Legend row
leg_items = [(C_JS,"JavaScript"),(C_PY,"Python"),(C_TS,"TypeScript"),(C_RUST,"Rust"),(C_GO,"Go")]
total_leg_w = sum(tw(n, fJ_xs)+72 for _,n in leg_items)
lx_start = MCENTER - total_leg_w//2
ly_ = FY + 100
lx_ = lx_start
for col_,name in leg_items:
    draw.rectangle([lx_, ly_+6, lx_+26, ly_+26], fill=col_)
    draw.text((lx_+36, ly_), name, font=fJ_xs, fill=col_)
    lx_ += tw(name, fJ_xs) + 72

# ─── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
print(f"Saved: {out}  ({W}×{H})")

arguments.content:
"""
State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Infographic Poster v3 (FINAL MASTERPIECE)
Design Philosophy: Terminal Cartography
A1 Portrait: 3508 × 4961 @ 150 DPI

Final pass: glow layer composited beneath hero lines, perfect vertical rhythm,
no text overflow, tighter callout panels, consistent typographic scale.
"""

import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter, ImageChops

W, H = 3508, 4961
DPI  = 150

# ─── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (11, 15, 20)
BG_PANEL    = (16, 22, 32)
GRID_COL    = (20, 28, 42)
RULE        = (38, 52, 72)
RULE_BRIGHT = (55, 78, 110)

C_JS   = (97, 175, 239)
C_PY   = (255, 189, 46)
C_TS   = (82, 219, 163)
C_RUST = (255, 121, 76)
C_HTML = (45, 62, 90)
C_SQL  = (52, 72, 98)
C_JAVA = (56, 76, 104)
C_GO   = (76, 150, 190)

WHITE       = (240, 245, 252)
WHITE_DIM   = (140, 158, 182)
WHITE_FAINT = (56, 76, 102)
WHITE_GHOST = (30, 42, 60)

FONTS = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(name, size):
    try: return ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + name, size)
    except: return ImageFont.load_default()

# Typography system — 5 scales
fH1  = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     215)   # Masthead
fH2  = F("GeistMono-Bold.ttf",        190)   # Year stamp
fH3  = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf",     84)   # Chart callouts
fH4  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",    56)   # Section labels
fH5  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",    44)   # Sub-section
fD1  = F("GeistMono-Bold.ttf",         50)   # Data labels
fD2  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf",  40)   # Data body
fD3  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf",  30)   # Fine labels
fD4  = F("GeistMono-Regular.ttf",      24)   # Micro
fMono= F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf",     40)   # Bold mono accents

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(t, f): bb=f.getbbox(t); return bb[2]-bb[0]
def th(t, f): bb=f.getbbox(t); return bb[3]-bb[1]
def ct(d, t, cx, y, f, c): d.text((cx-tw(t,f)//2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
def rt(d, t, rx, y, f, c): d.text((rx-tw(t,f), y), t, font=f, fill=c)

def blend(a, b, t): return tuple(int(a[i]+(b[i]-a[i])*t) for i in range(3))
def abg(col, a): return blend(BG, col, a/255)
def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, c=None, t=2):
    if c is None: c = RULE
    d.rectangle([x0,y,x1,y+t], fill=c)

def dot(d, x, y, col=RULE_BRIGHT, r=6):
    d.ellipse([x-r,y-r,x+r,y+r], fill=col)

# ─── Canvas + glow layer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), BG)
glow  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), (0,0,0))
d_base = ImageDraw.Draw(base)
d_glow = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)

# Grid on base
GS = 118
for gx in range(0, W, GS): d_base.rectangle([gx,0,gx+1,H], fill=GRID_COL)
for gy in range(0, H, GS): d_base.rectangle([0,gy,W,gy+1], fill=GRID_COL)

ML = 164; MR = W-164; MC = (ML+MR)//2

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MASTHEAD
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = 148
d_base.text((ML, y), "JETBRAINS  ·  STATE OF DEVELOPER ECOSYSTEM  ·  2024",
            font=fD4, fill=WHITE_GHOST)
y += 52
hrule(d_base, y, ML, MR, RULE_BRIGHT, 2)
y += 50

for line, col in [("STATE OF", WHITE), ("DEVELOPER", WHITE), ("ECOSYSTEM", C_JS)]:
    d_base.text((ML, y), line, font=fH1, fill=col)

def draw_thick_line(draw_obj, pts, col, thick):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0=pts[i]; x1,y1=pts[i+1]
        for off in range(-(thick//2), thick//2+1):
            draw_obj.line([(x0,y0+off),(x1,y1+off)], fill=col, width=1)

def draw_dashed(draw_obj, pts, col, thick):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0=pts[i]; x1,y1=pts[i+1]
        dx=x1-x0; dy=y1-y0
        dist=max(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),1)
        n=max(int(dist/32),1)
        for s in range(n):
            t0=s/n; t1=(s+0.5)/n
            draw_obj.line([
                (int(x0+dx*t0),int(y0+dy*t0)),
                (int(x0+dx*t1),int(y0+dy*t1))
            ], fill=col, width=thick)

            font=fD3, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y += 58
hrule(d_base, y, ML, MR, RULE, 3)
y += 80
MAST_END = y

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION HEADER helper
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def sec_hdr(y, label, x=ML):
    d_base.text((x, y), label, font=fH4, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
    hrule(d_base, y+62, x, MR if x==ML else x+600, RULE, 2)
    dot(d_base, x-1, y+63)
    return y+92

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CHART: Language trajectories 2017-2024
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = sec_hdr(MAST_END, "01  /  TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES  2017 – 2024")

CHART_L = ML + 72
CHART_R = MR - 20
CHART_T = y + 20
CHART_B = CHART_T + 920
CHART_W = CHART_R - CHART_L
CHART_H = CHART_B - CHART_T

years5 = [2017,2019,2021,2023,2024]

def yx(yr):
    idx=years5.index(yr)
    return CHART_L + int(idx/(len(years5)-1)*CHART_W)

def vy(pct, top=76):
    return CHART_B - int((pct/top)*CHART_H)

# Guide lines
for gv in [20,40,60]:
    gy = vy(gv)
    d_base.rectangle([CHART_L, gy, CHART_R, gy+1], fill=(28,40,58))

hrule(d_base, CHART_B, CHART_L, CHART_R, RULE_BRIGHT, 2)

# Year ticks
for yr in years5:
    vx = yx(yr)
    d_base.rectangle([vx, CHART_T, vx+1, CHART_B], fill=(24,34,50))
    d_base.rectangle([vx-1, CHART_B, vx+2, CHART_B+18], fill=RULE_BRIGHT)

# ─── Polyline / area fill functions ──────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_area(draw_obj, pts, col, alpha):
    if len(pts)<2: return
    poly_pts = list(pts) + [(pts[-1][0], CHART_B), (pts[0][0], CHART_B)]
    draw_obj.polygon(poly_pts, fill=abg(col, alpha))

def draw_thick_line(draw_obj, pts, col, thick):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0=pts[i]; x1,y1=pts[i+1]
        for off in range(-(thick//2), thick//2+1):
            draw_obj.line([(x0,y0+off),(x1,y1+off)], fill=col, width=1)

def draw_dashed(draw_obj, pts, col, thick):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0,y0=pts[i]; x1,y1=pts[i+1]
        dx=x1-x0; dy=y1-y0
        dist=max(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),1)
        n=max(int(dist/32),1)
        for s in range(n):
            t0=s/n; t1=(s+0.5)/n
            draw_obj.line([
                (int(x0+dx*t0),int(y0+dy*t0)),
                (int(x0+dx*t1),int(y0+dy*t1))
            ], fill=col, width=thick)

def glow_pt(x, y, col, r=14):
    # Draw glow on both base (subtle) and glow layer (bright)
    for g_draw, alpha_scale in [(d_base, 0.3), (d_glow, 1.0)]:
        for gr in range(r*4, 0, -2):
            a = int(80 * alpha_scale * (1 - gr/(r*4)))
            gc = abg(col, a) if g_draw == d_base else blend((0,0,0), col, a/255)
            g_draw.ellipse([x-gr,y-gr,x+gr,y+gr], fill=gc)
    d_base.ellipse([x-r,y-r,x+r,y+r], fill=col)

# Series data
series = [
    # (name, data, color, line_thick, is_hero, is_dashed)
    ("HTML/CSS",   {2017:60,2019:61,2021:60,2023:52,2024:51}, C_HTML, 3, False, True),
    ("SQL",        {2017:42,2019:56,2021:54,2023:52,2024:48}, C_SQL,  3, False, True),

    ("Go",         {2017:17,2019:20,2021:23,2023:18,2024:17}, C_GO,   3, False, True),
    ("Rust",       {2017: 0,2019: 6,2021: 8,2023: 7,2024: 8}, C_RUST, 5, False, False),
    ("JavaScript", {2017:65,2019:69,2021:69,2023:61,2024:61}, C_JS,   9, True,  False),
    ("Python",     {2017:32,2019:49,2021:52,2023:54,2024:57}, C_PY,   9, True,  False),

    if dashy:
        draw_dashed(d_base, pts, col, thick)
    else:
        draw_thick_line(d_base, pts, col, thick)
        # Glow line on glow layer
        draw_thick_line(d_glow, pts, blend((0,0,0),col,0.5), thick+6)

# Dots + end labels
label_offsets = {
    "JavaScript": (30, -24),
    "Python":     (30, -24),
    "TypeScript": (30, -24),
    "Rust":       (22, -20),

for name,vals,col,thick,hero,dashy in series:
    last_yr = max(vals)
    last_v  = vals[last_yr]
    if last_v==0: continue
    ex,ey = yx(last_yr), vy(last_v)
    if hero:
        glow_pt(ex, ey, col, r=14)
    else:
        d_base.ellipse([ex-8,ey-8,ex+8,ey+8], fill=col)
    # Label
    ox, oy = label_offsets.get(name, (22,-18))
    lx, ly = ex+ox, ey+oy
    font  = fD2 if hero else fD4
    color = col
    d_base.text((lx, ly), f"{name}  {last_v}%", font=font, fill=color)

# Composite glow
glow_blurred = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=18))
base = ImageChops.add(base, glow_blurred)
d_base = ImageDraw.Draw(base)

CHART_END = CHART_B + 80

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CALLOUT TRIO
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CT = CHART_END
CB = CT + 290
hrule(d_base, CT, ML, MR, RULE_BRIGHT, 2)
hrule(d_base, CB, ML, MR, RULE_BRIGHT, 2)

CW3 = (MR-ML)//3
for cx_ in [ML+CW3, ML+CW3*2]:
    d_base.rectangle([cx_, CT, cx_+2, CB], fill=RULE)
ccx = [ML+CW3*i+CW3//2 for i in range(3)]

trios = [
    ("61%","JavaScript","plateau · 2024",C_JS),
    ("57%","Python","closing the gap",C_PY),
    ("12→37%","TypeScript","8-year breakout",C_TS),
]
for i,(num,lang,sub,col) in enumerate(trios):
    cx = ccx[i]
    ct(d_base, num,  cx, CT+30,  fH3, col)
    ct(d_base, lang, cx, CT+122, fH5, WHITE)
    ct(d_base, sub,  cx, CT+178, fD3, WHITE_FAINT)

TRIO_END = CB + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

d_base.rectangle([SP_MID, SP_TOP, SP_MID+2, SP_BOT], fill=RULE)

PI_TOP = SP_TOP + 80
PI_L   = ML

promise = [

d_base.text((PI_L+bx_pad, pn_y+100), "TypeScript & JavaScript coexist, not compete", font=fD3, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

# ── Database lines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_L = SP_MID + 80; DB_R = MR - 20
DB_T = SP_TOP + 80; DB_B = SP_BOT - 40
DB_W = DB_R - DB_L; DB_H = DB_B - DB_T
db_yrs = [2019,2022,2024]

def dyx(yr): return DB_L + int(db_yrs.index(yr)/(len(db_yrs)-1)*DB_W)

for gv in [20,40,60]:

for lang,vals,col,thick,filled in db_s:
    pts=[(dyx(yr),dvy(v)) for yr,v in sorted(vals.items())]
